content: Finally an app that lets you write lyrics with the beat on the same screen!! Also has a nice rhyme lookup built in. 10/10 recommend. Makes writing a new song way easier, don’t need to use Notes anymore. 🔥
name: AgarPlayer76

content: Everything is organized and simple to use. Though I’m not a song writer this app does make it much easier to write to music. You can even play inspirational instrumentals and write poetry as well.
name: bastienMarc

content: Definitely a cool app and I use it a lot. It’s super simple and easy-to-use and If you like to vibe out and write this is the app for you! I recommend it. 👌
name: Malia-M

content: This app is perfect for any musician or anyone who loves to write! It’s great to see something like this out, because it is unlike anything else on the market.
name: nicole asf165

content: This app is by far one of the best I’ve used. It’s so convenient to have the beat there while writing.
name: Dj

content: Sometimes inspiration strikes while you’re exploring other music, but you lose your ideas by the time you’re in a space to write it down, LOVE the note feature during videos!! My favorite part so far is the rhyming word feature and challenge posed by timed writing.
name: jaimejaleh
